reference.title: The Big Prize
reference.evidence: 位置への質問で厳密に上位の左右個数を得る。種類別個数が直上種類の個数の二乗より大きいため、最下位以外は高々472位置、その位置の返答和は高々26となる。最下位を確定し、区間外の上位個数を保って中央から走査・二分する。D_H(k)の帰納で初期走査を含む4779問以内を保証し、毎回答後に合法な整合列が残る適応graderにも対応する。
reference.verificationNotes: 2026-10-15に公式原典4頁/公式解説2頁/主催配布SWE・MAC検索本文/Day2NoticeとJP日別一覧を再確認。N3..200000/c1=1/c[t+1]>c[t]^2/適応grader/全履歴に少なくとも一つの合法completion/hard10000・満点5000/二種類subtask1も10000を確認。実header bytes未取得は保持し、generic署名+Notice型対応とsynthetic prize.hによるadapter検査を区別。公式の省略された4759実装は検証済みとせず、独立した中央走査手順を完全証明。D_H(k)の全分岐、最下位以外の返答和26、prefix吸収、二種類fastpath19を合わせ最悪4779問。単一可視実MDX C++20を抽出し通常/ASan+UBSanともgeneric9804568checks/26286API/checksum12118485734290438769、別sourceadapter285071checks/370API/checksum12874631007238081852成功。全合法N3..16配列23807、N3..12の全1966非空adaptive回答分岐/939終端、N200000の72合法completion族から3適応transcript、全13098個数鎖/全524286marked配置、106最大境界/乱択生成を検証。初回unknown/status/全fieldは未変更、後続positiveはroot独立review後のみ、登録前coverage加算なし。

problemFeature.title: The Big Prize
features: 位置を質問すると、厳密に上位の個数が左右別に返る。種類ごとの個数は、直上の種類の個数の二乗より大きい。
唯一の最上位を探す。各返答後に全履歴と整合する合法な列が一つ以上残り、隠し列が最初に固定されるとは限らない。
長さ3〜20万、満点5000質問。返答の再利用と区間内の上位個数で最悪質問数を保証する。

functions: Result find_unique_best(int n,const Oracle& oracle,int budget=5000)

contract.oracle: after every reply at least one entire legal rank sequence remains compatible with the full transcript;an initially fixed legal sequence is a special case,not a requirement
contract.reply: two int values left/right strict higher counts;index0..N-1
contract.budget: 0..10000;default5000;check before a new external query;cache hits spend no questions
contract.output: unique best index in every remaining completion plus counters
contract.referenceTotal: -1 if found before a cheapest reference was established;otherwise exact countS of noncheapest positions
contract.invalidInput: invalid_argument before queries for N/budget/empty callback
contract.invalidReply: runtime_error when detected range/classification/interval-count/capacity/progress contradiction;not a complete arbitrary-lie verifier
contract.callbackAndAllocationExceptions: propagate unchanged;past external callback effects cannot be rolled back
contract.lifetime: oracle reference not retained;all state local;return is a value;no input array is required
contract.state: reentrant,nested calls/result copying or mutation isolated
contract.adapter: PRIZE_ORIGINAL_GRADER includes distributed prize.h;validate vector reply size2;no I/O

api.time: O(N+Q) local,external oracle cost excluded;cache visits add at most19reuses
api.space: O(N+logN);oneN-element Reply cache and reserved32-frame pending stack
api.integerSafety: N<=200000 validated before allocation;reply components checked against index andN-1-index before addition,so finite sums fit int;all legal sums<=472;positions/midpoints/counters/budget<=source bounds. No multiplication or squaring in public exploration.

proofObligations.sumIdentifiesLevel: The response sum is the cumulative number of all strictly higher kinds. Every kind has a positive count by the growth condition,so sums strictly increase with lower kinds;sum0 uniquely identifies the best.
proofObligations.countBounds: The minimal six-kind chain1,2,5,26,677,458330 exceeds N200000,so at most5kinds. A nonlast count c needs a following count>=c²+1,so c+c²+1<=N andc<=446. For5kinds its predecessors are<=21and4,henceS<=472. Fewer kinds giveS<=468,447or1. A noncheapest reply counts only preceding kinds;max26 for5kinds,max22 for4,and no larger for fewer.
proofObligations.certainCheapest: A sum>26 is cheapest in every legal completion. Otherwise473distinct prefix indices contain a cheapest by S<=472;the observed largest sum equals the actual cheapest sum in every surviving completion. N<473 fully scans and finds the best.
proofObligations.exactIntervalCounts: Frames store exact global noncheapest counts before/after[l,r]. The count k=S-before-after holds in every completion. Scan q noncheapest indices from the midpoint to the right. At a cheapest j with response(L,R),left child count=L-before-q,right=R-after;outside counts(left)=(before,R+q),(right)=(L,after). If all k consumed,stop. If right boundary crossed first,only left child remains with after+q.
proofObligations.searchPotential: For length<=2^H-1 defineD_H(k)=Σd0..H-1 min(2^d,k). No position revisited in this search;for k>=2^(H-1),D equals full size bound. For smaller k,after q<k scanned specials and one cheapest,children sum k-q andcost<=q+1+D_(H-1)(a)+D_(H-1)(b)<=q+D_H(k-q)<=D_H(k). The last D term is linear through k,absorbing q. All-k-consumed and right-boundary-without-cheapest cases are separately bounded. Child length<=floor(parent/2).
proofObligations.prefixAbsorption: For early sure cheapest after c earlier prefix specials,read=c+1 andsuffix special countS-c. SinceD18 has a linear last term through472,c+1+D18(S-c)<=1+D18(S)<=4760. If full473prefix withoutsum>26,S<=26 and473+D18(26)=842.
proofObligations.fastPath: Initialsum1 means exactly one strictly higher object,necessarily the unique best. While later replies sum1 their0/1left/right values correctly halve the interval;sum>1 falls back without using it as a binary decision. At most1+height(N-1)<=19 visits. All two-kind source arrays terminate here.
proofObligations.fullBudget: D18(472)=4759,D18(26)=369;max(4760,842)+19=4779<5000. Cache suppresses repeated actual questions. The helper returnsmin(N,4761+bit_width(N-1))<=4779. This is a deterministic worst-case bound,not maximum observed query count or expectation.
proofObligations.adaptiveCorrectness: Every count/type distinction and pruning statement is valid for every legal completion consistent with all prior replies;no initial fixed sequence is assumed. Querysum0 fixes the best in all completions. A best remains in an active frame until found because only frames whose marked count is0are discarded.

complexity.notClaimed: The exact4759 official Solution3 implementation is not reconstructed;this fully specified independent method uses a proved4779 bound. Maximum observed4112 is not substituted for the proof.

guards.question: 位置を選ぶと、厳密に上位の個数が左右別に返りますか？
guards.explanation: 返答は二つの整数です。位置の並び自体には単調性を仮定しません。

guards.question: 最上位が一個で、下位の種類の個数は直上の種類の個数の二乗より多いですか？
guards.explanation: 上位から種類を並べ、隣り合う全ての種類で厳密な個数条件が成り立ちます。

guards.question: 長さ3〜20万で、整合する返答の下で5000質問以内に探しますか？
guards.explanation: 各返答後に、過去の全返答と整合する合法な列が少なくとも一つ残ります。列が最初に固定される場合も含みます。

oracleIndependence.fixedArrays: For every legal sequence N3..16 (two or three kinds are all possibilities there),directly scan all positions to form both strict-rank counts. No published interval/type classification is used to create replies.
oracleIndependence.smallAdaptive: N3..12 all legal arrays:replay every nonempty response bucket in the entire deterministic decision tree;1976nodes/1966branches/939terminal transcripts,each output must be best in every surviving completion. Heuristic compatible-bucket runs also coverN8..16.
oracleIndependence.largeAdaptive: N200000 finite family of72valid full arrays acrossS26/S27/S472,stored as complete rare-position/type descriptions with all other positions cheapest. Three coherent answer-bucket choices retain nonempty compatible completions;the source is not falsely fixed. This does not claim enumeration of all large legal sequences.
oracleIndependence.potentialLemma: Every one of524286binary marked patterns of lengths1..18 is explored by a separate scalar marked-set model;check no revisit and D_H(k) bound. Also enumerate all scalar scan/split inequality parameters H<=18,k<=472 below saturation.
oracleIndependence.countBounds: All13098feasible noncheapest count chains belowN200000 exactly enumerate S<=472 andnoncheapest replysum<=26.
oracleIndependence.maximum: 106fixed fullsource/boundary/random cases includeN200000,alltwo-kind best positions,472special spread/cluster/prefix placements,S25/26/27 boundaries,473prefix and binary-length boundaries,and64random legal count chains. Three maximum source-adapter cases independently repeatS472/S26/two-level arrays.

countSemantics.checks: Executed require assertions,not every scanned array element.
countSemantics.apiCalls: Instrumented find_unique_best/find_best invocations,including invalid/paused adaptive replays;bound helper calls not included.
countSemantics.fixedArrayOracleCalls: Calls through Fixed literal/precomputed-rank context;separate adaptive-query counters are not added to this field.
countSemantics.allLegalArraysN3to16: Complete actual source arrays for these lengths;minimum four-kind length34 means none omitted.
countSemantics.allMarkedPatternsN1to18: Binary shape stress for the amortized query proof,not source rank arrays.
countSemantics.normalRss: Includes driver oracles/generated arrays and allocator,not API-only storage.
countSemantics.asanRss: Includes AddressSanitizer allocation quarantine;LeakSanitizer disabled as required by platform.

verification.allocationExceptionReasoning: No catch or shared mutable algorithm state;local vectors/std::function invocation propagate exceptions with standard RAII. Callback exceptions at every position of sample and main-search cases are tested;allocation failure injection itself is not claimed.

technicalFindings.method: 返答和で価値を分類する。同価値のi<jでleft[j]−left[i]は内部の厳密に高価な数で、既知分を引いた残数0なら枝を捨てられる。ただし全体の満点質問数は未確認。
technicalFindings.complexity: 局所差分の正当性とN<=20万で最安以外が高々472個であることを確認した。公式効率実装の4759回/必要5000回の探索全体と償却上界は未確認。
independentProofSupplement: 価値が上がるごとに正の個数を累積するため、左右和が等しいことと同価値が同値。
同価値端点i<jでは二つのleftの差が開区間のより高価な数に一致する。
同じ返答列に整合する全配列でこの等式は不変で、既知の高価な位置を引いて0なら未調査内部にdiamondはない。
合法な個数列の整数列挙で最安type以外の最大472を得るが、その値だけから5000回を結論しない。
implementationRequirements: 主な探索順序/分岐を具体化し、全整合補完への正しさと5000回以内を先に証明する。
証明できるまで完成記事やcoveredにしない。

probeEvidence.verified: Response sum identifies prize level. Equal-level boundary left-count difference is exact number of strictly better prizes in between; zero remaining count safely prunes for every transcript-consistent fixed completion. Count growth is checked with exact integer recursion.
probeEvidence.unconfirmed: No implementation or independent worst-case proof of the official efficient 4759/required5000-query strategy. Fixed-sequence gap tests do not establish adaptive-grader full-score correctness/budget.
